info.name: Trustless Work Core API
info.description:
Complete endpoint collection for the Trustless Work Core API (as of 2026-07-15).

AUTH: collection-level x-api-key header = {{apiKey}} (format id.secret). Human wallet sessions use a Bearer token instead — set {{bearerToken}} and switch a request's Authorization to Bearer where needed.

CORE FLOW: Escrow Transactions build an unsignedXdr -> sign it in the wallet -> Stellar > Send transaction submits the signedXdr.

Set the collection variables (baseUrl, apiKey, and the sample G_/C_ addresses) before use.
